reference.limits: No key, no published rate limit. API Terms of Service embedded in the response: 'Please link back (with follow, and without nofollow!) to the URL on Remote OK and mention Remote OK as a source … If you do not we'll have to suspend API access'; do not use the Remote OK logo without permission. No key, no published rate limit. Site legal page has no bot clause; robots.txt blocks CCBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-Web, Bytespider … with Disallow: / for unlisted agents (the API is the sanctioned path).

adapter.rate_note: No rate limit is published; the feed's in-payload terms only ask for attribution. Kept to one request every two seconds because a single call returns the whole board.
adapter.terms: Element 0 of the feed carries the API Terms of Service: 'Please link back (with follow, and without nofollow!) to the URL on Remote OK and mention Remote OK as a source, so we get traffic back from your site. If you do not we'll have to suspend API access. Please don't use the Remote OK logo without written permission as it's a registered trademark, please DO use our name Remote OK though.' (https://remoteok.com/api, opened 2026-09-24).

search.note: Single keyless JSON array with no documented query, location, page or limit parameters: nothing is sent and the whole feed (a few hundred rows) is returned; filter client-side. Element 0 of the feed is the legal notice (id null) and is dropped by the runtime. Fields per the feed: slug, id, epoch, date, company, company_logo, position, tags[], description (HTML), location, apply_url, salary_min, salary_max, url; currency is not stated. Attribution: link back (follow) to the Remote OK URL and name Remote OK as the source.
